property='target.{MSH:MessageType.messagetype}' action='set' /> <assign value='"A31"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='$Translate(..CurrentDateTime("%c(8,1,4)")," :.","")' property='target.{MSH:MessageControlID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"T"' property='target.{MSH:ProcessingID.processingID}' action='set' <if condition='$L(source.homephone)>9' > <true> <assign value='"193"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> <assign value='$E(source.homephone,1,3)' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).Areacitycode}' action='set' /> <assign value='$E(source.homephone,4,10)' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).Phonenumber}' action='set' /> </true> </if> property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(1).Areacitycode}' action='set' /> <assign value='$E(source.cellphone,4,10)' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(1).Phonenumber}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='$L(source.preferredphone)>0' > <true> <assign value='"1"' property='target.{OBX:SetIDOBX}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CE"' property='target.{OBX:ValueType}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.prefPhoneNcid' property='target.{OBX:ObservationIdentifier.identifierST}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.preferredphone' property='target.{OBX:ObservationValue(1)}' condition='$L(source.email)>0' > <true> <assign value='source.email' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='"50450665"' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).addresstype}' action='set' /> </true> </if>
